title: [GMCP 203.004.03] Integration: Legacy lifecycle compatibility and governed deprecation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-004-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: GMCP interoperates with pinned older MCP revisions through isolated compatibility adapters for initialize/initialized, ping, legacy HTTP+SSE, resource subscriptions, roots, sampling, elicitation, logging, and legacy task shapes without weakening the modern path. Version selection is deterministic, downgrade is visible, every deprecated feature has telemetry and a tested removal policy, and no legacy state crosses tenant or connection boundaries. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
